assessmentQuestionVersion.name: RecWater_RiskAssessment_Q8
assessmentQuestionVersion.responseValues: Low operator competency: Frequent operator turnover, limited training or experience, significant knowledge gaps, repeated delays in responding to follow-up requests, or failure to appropriately recognize, report, or respond to operational incidents. Moderate operator competency: Adequate operator knowledge and oversight, but occasional turnover, training gaps, delayed follow-up, or uncertainty regarding regulatory requirements. High operator competency: Stable operator coverage with demonstrated knowledge of pool operation and regulatory requirements. Responds appropriately to incidents, reports notifiable events when required, and addresses follow-up requests in a timely manner.
